planted.line: While the seeds of life and the seeds of change were planted
stanza: Lost in thought and lost in time
While the seeds of life and the seeds of change were planted
Outside, the rain fell dark and slow
While I pondered on this dangerous but irresistible pastime

planted.line: Their teeth are bare, their feet are planted
stanza: Their teeth are bare, their feet are planted
Their smirking at him like he’s dirt
He feels weak with confusion, like
He watches them walk to the doors
